headline: DayOne Weighs US IPO Options Amid Data Center Sector Volatility
summary: Singapore's DayOne is reportedly weighing options for a US initial public offering following recent volatility in the data center market.
why: IPO deliberations by regional tech-related firms signal fundraising sentiment in overseas equity markets.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Market conditions dictate the timing and valuation of cross-border public listings.
